{"artifact":"SmeDossierEnvelope","schema_version":"0.4.0","stage_id":"02.dossier_sections","probe":"rdmv-sd-x","lineage":{"input_manifest_sha256":"cf881da0a3c701d981b2c80729f4b3f805b3d9d2aef43ac453fe1999f0bb633b","candidate_lineage_id":"2026-10-28-rdmv-sd-class-std:lineage:78","source_registry_sha256":"a4e51960bfe4da242ea11046073ac8d3d0353ce120a5409a11c1f9ab4c4da57a","source_liveness_sha256":"1aea607665fc1312b9a6988c94545b32e414886d6d428b2b6d66e4261f9397f1"},"envelope_scope":{"kind":"partial_chunk","assigned_section_ids":["C2"],"chunk_index":1,"chunk_total":1},"section_char_limit":12000,"sections":[{"section_id":"C2","chunk_id":"C2.01","merge_seq":1,"domain":"Night, work zones, winter and rural driving","heading":"C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Night, work zones, winter and rural driving","learner_facing":false,"markdown":"## C2 — Knowledge continuation and confusables: Night, work zones, winter and rural driving

FACT_ID: sec18-R01 | anchor: A67
In the first winter storm, drive slowly, leave extra following room and refresh winter-driving habits. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R02 | anchor: A67
For the winter conditions described, the handbook advises well below the posted limit and avoiding sudden sharp turns. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R03 | anchor: A67
The winter paragraph recommends light braking by gentle pumping but does not distinguish ABS-equipped vehicles there. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R04 | anchor: A67
Allow extra winter travel time, consider another route and stay home if conditions are too poor. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R05 | anchor: A67
Never use cruise control on slippery roads. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R06 | anchor: A67
Use headlights in winter and avoid high beams during a nighttime storm to prevent glare. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R07 | anchor: A67
Continue using the seatbelt in winter driving. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R08 | anchor: A67
Slow and leave snowplows ample room because they are wide, may work near the centerline and can throw up visibility-blocking snow. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R09 | anchor: A67
Where the posted limit is at least 35 miles per hour, stay at least 200 feet behind a snowplow displaying red or amber lights. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R10 | anchor: A67
A driver stuck on a closed road may face delayed rescue, a ticket and responsibility for rescue-related costs for people or the vehicle. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R11 | anchor: A67
On rural roads, remain alert, watch warnings and obey speed limits while accounting for their particular hazards. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R12 | anchor: A67
On gravel or dirt, slow down and increase following room because traction is lower and stopping may cause a skid. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R13 | anchor: A67
On a narrow rural road with little shoulder or a drop-off, reduce speed, center within the lane and watch for opposing vehicles encroaching. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R14 | anchor: A67
At a narrow or single-lane bridge, follow warning signs and take turns, with the first arriving driver generally having priority. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R15 | anchor: A67
On open-grate or steel bridges, reduce speed, increase following space and hold the wheel firmly because grip may be reduced. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R16 | anchor: A67
Slow and prepare to stop where woods, crops, blind bends or steep hills limit sight distance. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]

FACT_ID: sec18-R17 | anchor: A67
At an uncontrolled rural intersection, approach cautiously, slow down and prepare to stop for crossing or opposing traffic. [A67]
Source: [A67 -> src:rdmv-sd-l:south-dakota-department-of-public-safety:handbook:pdf-0067]
